title: Students and community members walk out over flag policy in Sonoma
seoTitle: Sonoma walkout over pride flag policy

tea.why: Protesters are demonstrating against the school board's new policy that led to the removal of the pride flag at Sonoma Valley High School.
tea.want: Demonstrators want the school board to reconsider the flag policy and allow the pride flag to remain on campus.
tea.changed: Oct 13: Hundreds of students and community members participated in a walkout and rally outside Sonoma Valley High School.

summary: Students and community members in Sonoma, California, staged a walkout and rally outside Sonoma Valley High School to protest a newly approved school district flag policy. The Sonoma Valley Unified School District Board of Trustees voted 3-2 on October 8 to restrict flag displays, effectively removing the pride flag that had flown at the high school since 2019. The demonstration was organized by the school's Gender & Sexualities Alliance (GSA) along with local groups Wake UP Sonoma and Sonoma Valley Pride. Protesters chanted, waved pride flags, and carried signs supporting the LGBTQIA+ community. School board President David Bell defended the policy, stating the district must represent all students equally.
demands: Allow the pride flag to be displayed on campus
response: School board President David Bell defended the policy, stating that the district's trustees must represent all students equally.

crowd.text: At least 250 people, some toting pride flags and banners, others carrying signs of support for the LGBTQIA+ community

updates.text: The Sonoma Valley Unified School District Board of Trustees voted 3-2 to approve a new flag policy restricting flag displays.
Hundreds of students and community members participated in a walkout and rally outside Sonoma Valley High School.
